entries.companyTitle: Technical Program Manager (TPM I) / Program Manager
entries.notes: Career stage IC2 (59-60) per Reddit/Blind posts by Microsoft employees (https://www.reddit.com/r/microsoft/comments/1jez7ty/levels_matching_between_m_and_ic/; https://www.teamblind.com/post/MSFT-career-stage-vs-Levelling-UiDsnkYv). levels.fyi US median TC (last 12 mo, pulled 2026-10-31 via levels.fyi MCP): TPM 59 ~$185k.
IC2. Same title as 59; higher pay band.
IC4 (63-64). TPM 63 ~$245k. Common external hire level for senior candidates.
IC4. TPM 64 ~$273k. Note: shiftmag.dev labels SDE 64 'Principal'; levels.fyi, designgurus and Microsoft employees on Reddit say 64 is still Senior. Treat 64=Senior.

IC5 (65-66). Microsoft postings say 'Technical Program Management IC5' for Principal TPM (e.g. https://builtin.com/job/principal-technical-program-manager/10481712; US base $142.8k-$274.8k). TPM 65 ~$325k.

Usually IC6 per Blind/Reddit (https://www.teamblind.com/post/what-is-microsoft-ic5-vs-ic6-level-tu7mjuf1; https://www.reddit.com/r/microsoft/comments/1jez7ty/levels_matching_between_m_and_ic/); one Blind poster says for program management IC6 covers 65/66/67, so career-stage IC is uncertain at 65-67. TPM 67 ~$468k.
Partner (68-69). Reddit poster thinks IC7 but says unsure; treat IC stage at 68 as unverified. TPM 68 ~$749k.
Consensus entry tier across designgurus/sph.sh/edencapital tables (https://www.designgurus.io/blog/microsoft-software-engineer-levels). Google TPM L3 ~$206k.

TPM TITLE TRAP: at Google L5 is titled 'TPM III', not Senior (https://careers.google.com/jobs/results/136954084836942534-technical-program-manager-iii/). Scope = MS Senior (63-64). Google TPM L5 ~$350k (pays above MS 65).

entries.companyTitle: Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM I)
entries.notes: TPM TITLE TRAP: Google 'Senior TPM' is L6 (staff-equivalent), so it maps to MS Principal 65-66, not MS Senior. Book of TPM table puts Google 'Senior TPM' at MS 63-64, which conflicts with levels.fyi titles. ~$455k.
Senior staff equivalent. Some tables put L7 at MS 65-67 (designgurus) or 67-68 (edencapital). ~$590k.
levels.fyi lists L8 as Director on the TPM ladder; SWE L8 = Principal Engineer = MS 68 (Partner) per designgurus/sph.sh.
Consensus; Book of TPM also maps Amazon L4 TPM to MS 59-60 (https://bookoftpm.com/4-Career-Path/job-levels/). ~$164k.

Amazon L6 is posted as 'TPM III' or 'Sr. TPM' (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/2967637/tpm-l6-fundamentum). All tables found put it at MS 63-64. One Blind anecdote: an MS 65 Principal TPM was offered Amazon L6 at similar TC (https://www.teamblind.com/post/Amazon-L6-offer-hREQdGqL), so the top of L6 overlaps MS 64-65. ~$292k.
Book of TPM: L7 Principal TPM = MS 65-67. Note that Amazon 'Principal' is harder to reach than MS 65 'Principal'; many MS 65s level at Amazon L6. ~$434k.
Book of TPM: Amazon L8 = MS 68-69 Partner. Amazon has no L9.
Meta TPMs use IC3-IC9 (SWE uses E3-E9). These are NOT Microsoft's IC career stages; Meta IC5 != Microsoft IC5.
Consensus senior tier. A Meta employee on Blind puts MS 63 at E4-E5 and 64 at E5 (https://www.teamblind.com/post/Meta-vs-Microsoft-WFYXhGTh). ~$346k.
Tables differ: designgurus E6-E7 = MS 65-67; Blind: 65=E5-E6, 66=E6, 67=E6-E7. ~$448k.
Blind poster maps E7 to MS 68 instead; edencapital maps E7 to 67-68. ~$655k.
Apple TPMs are often titled 'Engineering Program Manager (EPM)'. Tables: designgurus, edencapital.
designgurus: ICT5 = MS 65-67; edencapital: ICT5 also spans senior staff. ~$435k.
designgurus: ICT6 = MS 68-69. Few data points for TPMs.
Ladder from levels.fyi; tier placement is my inference from titles.
Pragmatic Engineer: Uber 5A = what most Big Tech calls senior (https://blog.pragmaticengineer.com/uber-engineering-levels/). ~$290k.

TITLE TRAP: Pragmatic Engineer says 5B matches staff at Meta/Amazon/Google (the SWE title became 'Staff' in 2022, but the TPM title on levels.fyi is still 'Senior TPM II'). ~$449k. Placing it at MS 65 is my inference.
Uber L6 = senior staff level by scope (Pragmatic Engineer). This MS mapping is my inference.
Airbnb SWE uses G7-G14; levels.fyi lists TPM as L3-L8. My inference from the title ladder (G8=SWE, G9=Senior, G10=Staff).
Airbnb TPM L6 ~$527k; Airbnb pays well above MS at the same tier.
LinkedIn is owned by Microsoft but uses its own staff-style ladder. LinkedIn 'IC3/IC4' numbers (SWE) are NOT Microsoft career stages. Tier placement is inferred from titles.
~$474k (pays closer to MS 67). Staff = principal tier.
Staff-style ladder (L5 Senior, L6 Staff, L7 Sr Staff, L8 Principal). No US TPM pay data; SWE pay is far above MS. Tier placement is inferred.
levels.fyi has no Snowflake TPM ladder; this uses the SWE ladder (IC3 Senior, IC4 Staff, IC5 Principal I). Inference.
Stripe ladder L1-L7; levels.fyi marks SWE L4 = Staff, which implies L3 = Senior. Inference.
levels.fyi: SWE L4 = Staff Engineer. TPM L4 ~$393k.
Nvidia TPM ladder IC1-IC8 (IC3 Senior TPM, IC6 Principal TPM). These are NOT Microsoft career stages. Placement inferred from titles plus pay.
Nvidia TPM IC4 ~$301k (between MS 64 and 65 pay).
~$432k. Title Principal; scope likely MS 67+. Inference.

salaryscript.com says Salesforce titles run about one notch above FAANG: Senior MTS ≈ Google L4 (https://salaryscript.com/salesforce-salary-negotiation/). levels.fyi TPM ladder shows only generic L3-L9 grades, so grade numbers are unmapped. Applying the SWE title ladder to TPM is my inference.
salaryscript: Lead MTS ≈ Google L5. SWE Lead MTS ~$313k.
Oracle uses IC-1..IC-7 for both tracks (not Microsoft career stages). Oracle TPM IC-3 ~$169k, SWE IC-3 ~$210k. Inference.
TITLE TRAP: Oracle 'Principal' (IC-4) is closer to MS Senior. TPM IC-4 ~$289k.
Intel grades. TPM Grade 7 ~$176k. Inference from pay plus titles.
TITLE TRAP: Intel 'Staff' (Grade 8, ~$230k) pays like MS 63, not MS Principal.
IBM bands. SWE: Band 7 Staff, 8 Advisory, 9 Senior, 10 STSM, D Distinguished. 'Staff' at IBM is junior. Inference.
TPM Band 8 ~$265k, but the sample is small.

ServiceNow IC ladder (not Microsoft career stages). TPM IC2 ~$159k (≈ MS 59 pay), so it may sit lower. Inference.
No Workday TPM ladder on levels.fyi; this uses the SWE P-ladder. SWE P3 ~$230k.
T-Mobile numbers run backwards (L9 Associate, L8 TPM, L7 Senior, L6 Principal). No US TPM pay data; SWE Principal ~$226k ≈ MS 62 pay. Inference.
TITLE TRAP: T-Mobile Principal pays like MS Senior. For KC this is the likely T-Mobile target role. Inference.
Letter bands (J-O) from the levels.fyi SWE ladder; no TPM data. SWE K ~$172k.
Boeing L1-L6 ladder. Pay is well below MS (SWE L4 ~$182k, L5 ~$220k). Scope by title vs. pay disagree. Inference.
levels.fyi has only a SWE ladder for Airbus and no US pay data; European grade systems differ. Treat this as a rough guess, not a mapping.
